what: Stacked cells in one spot (product box photos) switch to the next cell every 5 seconds with no in-between values, and the picture inside the new cell pops out from .5 scale in .1s with cubic-bezier(1,0,0,1) — a curve that grows almost entirely at the very last moment, giving a ”click” switching feel. After the last cell comes the first. It runs only while visible, and with pause: hover it stops while a hand is over it and restarts counting from the beginning on release

options.every: Interval for advancing to the next slide (seconds), default 5 — original Studio carousel autoDuration 5000
options.pause: If hover, it pauses while the pointer is over it (original mouseenter focus · mouseleave focusout)
options.--fx-from: Scale before popping out (css variable), default .5
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Cells to stack (the part sets them up with absolute inset 0) — is-on on the visible cell, is-pop on the one that just switched
options.[data-fx-part=pop]: Element to pop out of the cell (optional) — if none, the cell itself pops out
options.fx:swap: Event fired from the element on swap (detail.index)

use: …

from.where: index.html .kk-boxes (7 game boxes in the center of the Hero — original STUDIO carousel advance 1ms · 5s, box #fv-box appear scale .5 · .1s cubic-bezier(1,0,0,1))

index.html .nm-photos (7 rough-circle photos — original STUDIO carousel autoDuration 4000 · duration 1ms) · .nm-crew (4 member illustrations — autoDuration 2500 · duration 0). They only cut over with no pop-out, so --fx-from: 1
from.options: every: 4; pause: hover (photos) · every: 2.5; pause: hover (member) — --fx-from: 1 on the cell
